pois.name: Statue of Liberty
pois.description: The Statue of Liberty is a colossal neoclassical sculpture on Liberty Island in New York Harbor in New York City. The copper statue, a gift from the people of France, was designed by French sculptor Frédéric Auguste Bartholdi.

pois.name: Brooklyn Bridge
pois.description: The Brooklyn Bridge is a hybrid cable-stayed/suspension bridge in New York City, spanning the East River between the boroughs of Manhattan and Brooklyn. Opened on May 24, 1883, the Brooklyn Bridge was the first fixed crossing of the East River.

pois.name: One World Trade Center
pois.description: The World Trade Center is the tallest building in New York State and New York City. its 1,776 feet is an astonishing achievement of engineering. built after the 9/11 terrorist attacks it's a symbol of freedom and remembrence.

pois.description: The American Museum of Natural History is a natural history museum on the Upper West Side of Manhattan in New York City. In Theodore Roosevelt Park, across the street from Central Park, the museum complex comprises 26 interconnected buildings.
